P.name: Frost Shot
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}. {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not deal any additional damage.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} '''Ashe's''' basic attacks and ability hits apply ''Frost'' to enemies for 2 seconds, which {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 30}} for the duration.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} double ''Frost's'' slow strength to {{pplevel|key=%|20*2 to 30*2}}, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.

Q.name: Ranger's Focus
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}. The flurries {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}'' per arrow, but apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once.
Q.leveling2:

Q.description4: ''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Volley
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' shoots a volley of arrows in a cone in the target direction, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, and applying ''{{ai|Frost Shot 2|Ashe|Critical Slow}}'' to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit.
W.description2: Enemies can intercept multiple arrows but do not take damage from any beyond the first.

E.name: Hawkshot
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' sends a hawk spirit to a location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path{{ft|repeatedly for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after every 100 units traveled|for effectively up-to {{fd|1.8}} seconds at any location}}and at its destination for 5 seconds.
E.description2: '''Ashe''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Hawkshot'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.

R.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' fires a massive arrow of ice in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} it flies through. The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 1 for 5;1 to 3.5 for 10|0 to 2800|formula=1s for the first 800 units traveled; 1+(0.25 per 200 units)s beyond 800 units. ''This is capped at 2800 units traveled.''}} seconds, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them for 1 second.
R.description2: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage and afflicted with ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}''.
